notes.title: Update 2.4.7
notes.content:
Edited Shorty, Added Cooldown Timer [Cooldown Reduces per Shorty Copy]
Edited Maria,  Added Cooldown Timer [Points Increase per Maria Copy]
Edited Alanna, Added Cooldown Timer [Cooldown Reduces per Alanna Copy]

Changed Alanna's Ability

Removed Cards' Animated Backgrounds due to Graphical Issues
Changed Text on Archetype Achievements

Changed Point Bonus for Multiples of 100 Mouse Clicks
Changed the 'Exit Game' Option to Return to Main Menu w/Save
Changed Save and Load System, Making Both More Robust and Secure

Changed Card Purchasing System. 
[Players Can Now Purchase Cards [u]Before[/u] Obtaining Them via RNG]

Added Intended Music and Updated SFX to Avoid Audio Issues
Added More Configuration/Settings Options
Added Volume Slider for Music [During Main Game]

Additional Minor Quality of Life Changes
Additional Minor UI Changes
